summary: @c1-ease/commerce ships a postinstall beacon exfiltrating host identifiers to a hardcoded VPS
details: The package is a stub whose index.js exports a Proxy returning no-op functions, providing no real functionality. Its package.json declares a postinstall script that runs beacon.cjs, and index.js also invokes the same beacon on require(). beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, node version) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc with TLS certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The destination is an unaffiliated Contabo VPS unrelated to any declared publisher. The scoped name @c1-ease/commerce combined with a stub implementation and an install-time/require-time callback to an attacker-controlled host is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe that fingerprints internal build environments resolving the scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
